# Security Policy

## End of Life

This project has reached end of life and will be archived. It is no longer maintained, and no further releases, fixes, or security updates will be provided.

## Reporting Vulnerabilities

This project no longer accepts vulnerability reports. Please do not open security advisories, issues, discussions, or pull requests for this repository.

For maintained alternatives, we recommend using [Node-RED](https://nodered.org/) or [Apache Camel](https://camel.apache.org/) directly.

If you continue to use this project, you are responsible for assessing and mitigating any security risks.
